method: Isolated PhysX at the production 0.005 second timestep. Saved forklift, pallet, cargo and rack prefabs. Pickup, carrying and release use actual contacts; no load parenting, attached carrying joints or pose writes after initial placement. Actual installed warehouse static colliders and receiving-start clone, opened doors, independent delivery cargo, 30 Hz guide input.

checks.name: actual receiving dock pickup transport setdown
checks.expectation: The guide drives over the actual dock plate into the first delivery pallet, lifts through contact, reverses into the warehouse and releases it on the floor.

measurements.name: inner mast collision top after pickup
cargo position after reversing into warehouse
delivery pallet setdown drift after withdrawal

checks.name: deepest original trailer pallet pickup
checks.expectation: After the first three pallets are unloaded, the compact forklift enters the original full-scale trailer and retrieves the deepest package beneath its roof.
